summary.correctedReading: The unprobed family map is not primarily a TealScript oracle gap. It is a PineTS-trust gap: existing TealScript value-vector or grammar oracles cover every unprobed family, but PineTS was either not exercised against that family or could not run the current oracle shape.

examples: doc-comment annotations before function and variable forms
import declaration with explicit alias member call
built-in object and provider type annotations

sampleVerdicts.verdict: Existing value-vector oracle covers the behavior; the gap is that PineTS was not run against that member-specific oracle in the positive trust pass.
Existing grammar snippet/oracle covers the syntax; PineTS could not run or express the snippet, so the family stays unprobed rather than wrong.
Existing language vectors cover the behavior, but PineTS could not run at least one subcase. Split the family or isolate PineTS-compatible subcases before allowlisting.
